## What it is
Draw evacuation corridors down a burning topographic hillside. Drag from a cluster of figures toward the sea, release to send them walking; the wind-driven fire front descends while ember spot-fires ignite fresh green ahead of you. Reach the water to bank souls; lose 16 and the ridge is gone.
